List published CircleCI functions

## Usage

`circleci function list [flags]`

Aliases: `circleci function ls`

## Flags

| Flag                  | Description                                                                       |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-c, --config string` | path to the pipeline config file (default ".circleci/config.yml")                 |
| `--jq string`         | Process values from the response using jq syntax (see `circleci help formatting`) |
| `--json`              | Output as JSON                                                                    |
| `--pinned`            | list the functions declared in the local config                                   |

Global flags: `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Examples

- List published functions: 
  `circleci function list`
- List what this repository declares: 
  `circleci function list --pinned`
- Get just the names: 
  `circleci function list --json --jq '.[].name'`

## Details

List every published CircleCI function and its versions.

JSON fields: id, name, description, latest_version, versions.
With --pinned: alias, function, version.
